topic: Your Phone Sees Your Face as Numbers!
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your phone doesn't 'see' your face like you do. It's all about numbers, not images!

Here's how your phone unlocks with your face:
🔹 Your phone doesn't store a picture of you for Face ID.
🔹 Instead, advanced sensors map hundreds of unique facial points and distances.
🔹 These precise measurements are converted into a complex mathematical formula – your unique 'face-print'.
🔹 Every time you glance, it instantly recalculates and compares this 'math password' for a perfect match.

📌 Tap Save so you have this in your toolkit!
